    所有类和接口

    类
    说明
    BaronCard
    Represents the “Baron” card (Baron Talus) in the game.
    Card
    Abstract base class for all Love Letter game cards.
    Client
    A simple console‐based client for the Love Letter game server.
    CountessCard
    Represents the “Countess” card (Countess Wilhelmina) in the game.
    Deck
    Represents the draw deck in a Love Letter game.
    DiscardPile
    Represents the pile of discarded cards for the current round.
    GameMove
     
    GameSession
    Manages the state and flow of a Love Letter game session.
    GuardCard
    Represents the “Guard” card (Guard Odette) in the game.
    HandmaidCard
    Represents the “Handmaid” card (Handmaid Susannah) in the game.
    KingCard
    Represents the “King” card (King Arnaud IV) in the game.
    Main
     
    Player
    Represents a player in a Love Letter game, tracking their hand, elimination status, and the sum of card values they have discarded this round.
    PriestCard
    Represents the “Priest” card (Priest Tomas) in the game.
    PrinceCard
    Represents the “Prince” card (Prince Arnaud) in the game.
    PrincessCard
    Represents the “Princess” card (Princess Annette) in the game.

    main server class for the Love Letter game.
